Mortality during the reporting period (Død i opgørelsesperioden) for patients with atrial fibrillation is tracked nationally by the [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]]. An analysis of the 2023 data reveals a highly consistent national mortality rate, with only slight regional variations [^src1].

At the national level, 10% of patients (1,937 out of 19,671) died during the reporting period [^src1]. When comparing the five Danish regions, [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]], [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]], [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]], and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] all align perfectly with the national average, each recording a 10% mortality rate [^src1]. In absolute terms, [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] recorded the highest number of deaths (536), reflecting its larger overall patient base of 5,241 [^src1].

[[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] stands out as the sole outlier and trailer in mortality rates, being the only region to fall below the national average with a 9% mortality rate (418 deaths out of 4,446 patients) [^src1]. 

Because the available data consists of only a single dated section from 2023, no temporal trends, targets, or year-over-year improvements can be established for this specific metric.

| Sjælland | 326 | 10 | 2876 | 90 | 3202 |
| Syddanmark | 438 | 10 | 4142 | 90 | 4580 |
| Midtjylland | 418 | 9 | 4028 | 91 | 4446 |
| Nordjylland | 219 | 10 | 1983 | 90 | 2202 |

Entities: region-hovedstaden, region-sjaelland, region-syddanmark, region-midtjylland, region-nordjylland, databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark

Summary: Tabellen viser, at ca. 10 % af patienterne med atrieflimren døde i opgørelsesperioden på nationalt plan, med undtagelse af Region Midtjylland, hvor andelen er 9 %.
